summary: Iteration 105 — Verified all 3 Founder-reported fixes: (1) Book Manufacturing shows a clearly visible gold 'Authorize & Publish to QRU Online' button (authorize-store-btn) on the store-listing row for an unauthorized book. (2) Creative Assets shows a Remove button (ca-remove-<asset_id>) only for Rejected/Rights Hold/Revision Required assets — Locked assets show Approve/Lock/Reject/Archive but NO Remove button. (3) Printable Studio's Universal Page Layout Engine renders all 11 layout cards with data-testid=ps-layout-<id>, live preview via ps-live-preview updates when uploading and switching layouts, ps-fullbleed sets margin to 0.
